_comment: Copy to accounts_config.json and edit. Your copy is gitignored.
api_key_env / api_secret_env hold the NAMES of environment variables, not the
keys themselves. Put the actual keys in .env under those names. This keeps
credentials out of this file entirely.
position_usdt is the margin committed per trade for this account, in USDT.
With leverage 40 and position_usdt 15, the notional is 15 * 40 = 600 USDT.
Every enabled account trades the same signal, sized by its own settings.
